name: graphia
description: Document conversion app: Next.js client, FastAPI API, FastAPI processor.

scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory server python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev:processor: uv run --directory server python -m uvicorn processor.main:app --reload --port 8001
scripts.test:unit: uv run --directory server python -m pytest -m "not integration"
scripts.test:integration: uv run --directory server python -m pytest -m integration
scripts.lint:server: uv run --directory server python -m ruff check .
scripts.format:server: uv run --directory server python -m ruff format .
